notes: Add notes with a click in the MIDI editor, and mark several parts to keep with the scissors. More hotkeys, like Ctrl+S to save. Effects open beside the instrument, with undo and redo. Make your own plugin lists. Pick up where you left off when the app starts.

history.notes: Add notes with a click in the MIDI editor, and mark several parts to keep with the scissors. More hotkeys, like Ctrl+S to save. Effects open beside the instrument, with undo and redo. Make your own plugin lists. Pick up where you left off when the app starts.
Waves plugins now open the one you picked.

A new install now starts fresh, and uninstalling removes the app's settings.
Fixed: the welcome tour could flicker over other windows.
Fixed: with an instrument open, the welcome tour could hide behind it and leave the app unclickable.

New Record button: record what you play and save it as WAV, MP3 or FLAC.
MIDI editor: velocity and sustain pedal lanes under the notes.
Instrument list: type a letter to jump to instruments starting with it.
Plugin scan method was greatly optimized.
We greatly appreciate your using Instrument Player in its first month.

New features
- Count-in for recording in the MIDI editor: turn on the hand button beside Record, pick 1, 2, 3, 4 or 8 beats, and recording starts after the count.
- MIDI Replay has a new look.

New features
- Pencil mode and more MIDI editor keys, an Audio Effects button, a fullscreen MIDI editor, and Factory reset in Settings.

Issue fixes
- Audio interfaces no longer click when used alongside a DAW at a different sample rate.

New features
- MIDI editor with capture and replay.
- Effects rack for effect plugins.
